title: Repeat Reduction for Earlier Missing-Items Violations (Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts)
content:
A Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts shopper with other recent missing-items violations receives a repeat reduction when a missing-items dispute is decided.

**Clause.** The repeat reduction counts the other missing-items violations recorded on the account less than three whole months before the decision, the disputed one not counted: 2 or more take off 2 points; exactly one takes off 1 point; none takes off nothing.

## Ladder

| Other missing-items violations in the three months before the decision | Repeat reduction |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 points |
| Exactly 1 | 1 point |
| None | Nothing |

## Counting (hypothetical accounts)

| Missing-items violations recorded in the three months, including the disputed one | Others | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | Nothing |
| 2 | 1 | 1 point |
| 3 | 2 | 2 points |
| 5 | 4 | 2 points |

Violations of other types — late delivery, dropped batch and the rest — are not counted here, and a missing-items violation recorded four months before the decision falls outside the three months.
